method: Prefer an exact source UniProt Dbxref token on a target feature and follow its explicit Parent to one gene/pseudogene root. Only if no exact accession exists, allow one exact source-gene qualifier match; do not merge aliases, strip isoform suffixes, or infer positions.

fallbackEvidence.reason: No exact source UniProt accession in target Dbxref tokens; no isoform-suffix stripping or accession conversion applied.
